description: List your Evite events (GET /services/events/v1/). Returns events plus a totals breakdown. filterBy=others returns events where you are a guest. view "brief" answers one line per event (title — start — status), upcoming events only unless status is given, 25 per page unless numResults is given.

filterBy.description: Whose events to list: all, host (you are hosting), or others (you are a guest).

status.description: Repeatable status filter (upcoming, draft, archived, past, canceled). Default: upcoming + past; with view "brief", upcoming only.

view.description: Response shape. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns Evite's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which Evite fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs. "brief" answers one line per event — title — <ISO start or "no date"> — <status> — inside the untrusted-data envelope as `data`, with "-- none" for no events and "-- more" when the page came back full.

name: evite_list_events
